name: @odia/appv2
description: Sanskrit-in-Odia-script upgrade of the web app. Adds a Sanskrit lexicon, a sloka rule profile and an insert palette for rare liturgical marks.
//dependencies: Deliberately empty. Appv2 is NOT a member of the root package.json
'workspaces' array, because adding it there would mean editing an existing
file. @odia/core is reached through the vite alias and the tsconfig
'paths' entry (both point at ../core/src/index.ts), and the eval harnesses
import ../../core/src/*.js by relative path under tsx.
vite, tsx, vitest and smol-toml all resolve from the repo-root
node_modules/ by Node's upward walk, so there is nothing to install here.
Run from the repo root:  npx vite --config Appv2/vite.config.ts
